subject: SIG: Secure SDLC artifacts request — FinServCo
messages:
From: Dovetail Security <assessor@dovetailsec.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@finservco.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0000
Subject: SIG: Secure SDLC evidence request — FinServCo assessment

Hi Tessa,

As part of FinServCo's SIG review, we need a compact package of Secure SDLC artifacts focused on code review, CI/CD gate enforcement, secrets handling, and change controls. Preferably a single archive or a drive folder with the items below: 

- Evidence that code changes require peer review (policy + sample PRs showing reviewer approvals)
- CI/CD gate screenshots or logs showing a failed build/blocking condition and a passing build after remediation
- Proof of secrets management: vault policy, rotation schedule, and a sample redaction/replace event (no secrets in cleartext)
- Change management log showing approvals for a production deployment during the last 90 days
- A short CSV manifest listing files included and an optional attestation indicating who prepared the package

Deliverables should be sanitized for customer data. Can you get this to us within 72 hours? If you have a preference for format (Drive link vs. signed zip), let us know.

Thanks,
Sam Rivera
Senior Assessor, Dovetail Security
assessor@dovetailsec.com

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Dovetail Security <assessor@dovetailsec.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Secure SDLC evidence request — FinServCo assessment

Sam — thanks for the clear list. We can compile a sanitized package and share a Drive folder plus a signed attestation PDF. 72 hours is tight but doable — target EOD Monday (2028-06-17) unless you need it sooner.

Quick clarifications for packaging:
- For "sample PRs" do you need the full diff, or just PR metadata + reviewer timestamps? We prefer metadata + reviewer audit trail to avoid exposing customer code.
- For CI gate evidence we can include screenshots and the corresponding pipeline run IDs; is a pipeline run export (JSONL) acceptable?
- For secrets rotation, we will provide policy and a redaction event log (with secret IDs hashed).

Dev, Mina — can you pull the artifacts below and add brief notes per item (what's sanitized and where to find the upstream record)? I will assemble and hand off to Sam.

Tessa Morgan
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Dovetail Security <assessor@dovetailsec.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Secure SDLC evidence request — FinServCo assessment

Attaching the requested artifacts to a temporary, access-restricted Drive folder. Summary of what's included: 

- code-review-rollup-202805.zip — includes CSV index of PR numbers, reviewer usernames, approval timestamps, and the "merge_protection" flag. NO diffs; diffs are withheld per IP policy.
- ci_pipeline_gate_screenshots.pdf — three screenshots: failing unit-test stage (run-id: run_37819), fix commit pipeline, and the gated approval step showing required contexts.
- change_log_export_202806.jsonl — export of the change management system for the past 90 days; entries include change_id, owner, approvers (email), approval timestamps, target_env, and deployment_marker. Sensitive fields redacted.
- secret_rotation_policy_v2.docx — current vault policy with rotation cadence and KMS/HSM integration notes.
- sdlc_artifacts_manifest.csv — human-readable manifest mapping files to system IDs/links.

Drive link (access: assessor@dovetailsec.com granted): https://drive.redwood.example/secure/SIG/FinServCo/package-20280614

Notes on sanitization: 
- All secrets are referenced by vault IDs; any secret values are fully redacted.
- PR diffs withheld; we include verifier hashes for cross-checking only.
- Pipeline run exports are sanitized to remove customer PII.

If you need the raw pipeline logs instead of screenshots, let me know — we can provide time-limited access to the run export.

— Dev

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@finservco.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: assessor@dovetailsec.com
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 12:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Secure SDLC evidence request — FinServCo assessment

Thanks — quick question from the FinServCo security team: how do you enforce required reviewers for high-risk components (we have SEC-4321 linked to a custom service)? We need a short note or screenshot that shows the rule for that service and an example enforcement (a blocked merge due to missing reviewer).

Also, is there a way to correlate the change_log_export entries with the pipeline run IDs you provided? That mapping will help our audit trace.

Alex
Security Engineer, FinServCo

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@finservco.com>, Dovetail Security <assessor@dovetailsec.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SIG: Secure SDLC evidence request — FinServCo assessment

Alex — good questions. Per Dev's notes I've added two items to the Drive folder to address SEC-4321 specifically: 

- code-review-rollup-202805.zip -> directory "sec-4321-examples" contains a blocked-merge snapshot (screenshot) and the internal rule "required_reviewer=security_team" enforced by branch protection for the service repo.
- change_log_export_202806.jsonl includes a "pipeline_run_id" field for deploy-type entries; we added a small mapping CSV in the Drive folder that links change_id <-> pipeline_run_id for audit correlation.

I have also uploaded a signed attestation (attestation_signed_finservco.pdf) that confirms artifacts were prepared and sanitized by Redwood's compliance team. If you prefer a DocuSign flow, here's a link to the hosted attestation doc: https://docs.redwood.example/attestations/FinServCo-2028-06-14

Please confirm receipt and whether this package satisfies the SIG checklist or if you need additional raw exports (we can provide time-limited S3 access for deeper inspection).

Thanks — Tessa
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
